_comment: Dragon Dev Buddy project profile. Read by every skill in the pack. Regenerate with the buddy-setup skill.

project.name: renovate-presets
project.what_it_is: A shared Renovate configuration preset library for DragonSecurity. Consuming repos extend it via 'github>DragonSecurity/renovate-presets'; it governs update scheduling, grouping, and automerge policy across the org.
project.runtime: none — declarative config consumed by the Renovate bot at run time
project.deploy_target: GitHub repository; presets resolve live off the default branch, unpinned

security._exposure_note: Public GitHub repo. Consumers are DragonSecurity org repos. The read surface is public; the write surface (default branch) is the sensitive one.
security._data_sensitivity_note: No PII, no credentials, no secrets in scope. The risk model here is integrity and supply chain, not confidentiality: this repo decides what merges into other repos without human review.
security.auth_model: none in-repo; downstream effect is mediated by the Renovate bot's write permissions on consuming repos
trust_boundaries: Public package registries (npm, Docker Hub, Go proxy, GitHub Actions marketplace) -> Renovate. Upstream package contents are untrusted input.

This preset -> every consuming repo. Presets resolve live off the default branch and are not pinned by consumers, so a merged change here takes effect downstream immediately and without downstream review.
Renovate bot -> consuming repos. Branch-type automerge writes to protected-branch targets without opening a PR, bypassing code review entirely.
known_risk_areas: default.json packageRules[0] matches all packages ('matchPackagePatterns': ['*']) with automerge: true and automergeType: 'branch' — every non-major update across every ecosystem merges without a PR or human review.
vulnerabilityAlerts and osvVulnerabilityAlerts both automerge, so a poisoned or mis-tagged advisory-driven bump lands unreviewed.
No branch protection recorded on the default branch of this repo, which is the only gate on org-wide automerge policy.
No CI validation of preset syntax; test.json currently contains invalid JSON (trailing comma) and would fail Renovate parsing if referenced.
'matchPackagePatterns' is deprecated in current Renovate versions in favour of 'matchPackageNames' — a silent rule-matching failure is a policy failure.

engagement._comment: Empty: internal work on the org's own repository. No offensive engagement recorded.
